newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Wella off after profit fall.
newsitem.headline: German Wella off after profit fall.

text.p: Shares in German haircare and cosmetics group Wella AG fell on Tuesday after the group announced a drop in group pre-tax profit for the first nine months of the year to 84.4 million marks from 88.1 million.

Preference shares in Wella tumbled 26 marks, or three percent, to 850 on the IBIS electronic trade system, a slump reflected in the open of bourse trade, where the shares fell 24 marks to 845 in early dealings.
Meanwhile the DAX index of 30 leading shares was firmer, rising 8.5 points to 2,772.34 points.
Wella shares eased despite the fact that the company forecast it would see a slightly higher pre-tax profit for the full-year compared to last year, and a "clearly better" 1996 operating profit.
